backcountry2026.title: Ride Algorhythm Snowboard - 2026 - Men's
backcountry2026.hostNote: Retailer product page; not an official RIDE-hosted historical catalog. The page explicitly names the 2026 men's model and presents technical specs for all eight size variants.
backcountry2026.evidence: Directly rechecked 2026 men's product page on 2026-10-02. Lists 147, 151, 154, 155W, 157, 160W, 161, 164W; per-size effective edge, waist, triple sidecut radii, stance width and rider-weight ranges; product-wide 0.75 in stance setback; standard camber, directional twin, medium flex, 2x4 mount, Performance Core, Pre-Cured Glass/Carbon Array 5, Carbon Slimewalls, sintered base and three-year warranty. These are retailer-published specifications, not a RIDE-hosted historical tech sheet.

fuso2526.title: RIDE ALGORHYTHM 25-26
fuso2526.hostNote: Japanese retailer listing, not a brand source.
fuso2526.evidence: For 160W, the retailer listing supplies an independent cross-check of 264 mm waist, 9.4/6.9/9.4 m radii, 19 mm directional setback, reference stance 559 mm, 311 mm nose/tail width and 160-220+ lb rider-weight range. Identifies directional twin, standard camber, quadratic sidecut, Performance Core and Carbon Array 5. The listing could not be fetched directly in the current verification pass; preserve as previously captured evidence, not a new direct confirmation.

skiPro2526.title: Ride Algorythm 2026
skiPro2526.hostNote: Retailer product page; used only for corroboration of construction terminology.
skiPro2526.evidence: Lists 2026 standard camber, directional twin, Performance Core (Aspen/Bamboo/Paulownia), Carbon Array 5, Double Impact Plates, Pre-Cured Glass and Sintered 4000 Base; dimensions are consistent with other retailer listings.

officialSeasonPage.evidence: Used for season identity, available sizes and official all-mountain positioning only; not used as the source of historical 25/26 geometry.

units.sidecutRadiiM: m; three radii preserved in the order shown by the retailer
units.stanceSetback: Backcountry lists 0.75 in; FUSO lists 19 mm. Seed uses the independently corroborated 19 mm value as a positive setback distance.
units.riderWeightLb: lb; copied as displayed, including open-ended + ranges

product.retailerFlex: Medium (qualitative; no verified RIDE numeric flex scale for this season)

seedMappingNotes: Seed represents the existing 160W variant; the official-season size list has no standard 160. Keep length 160 plus widthVariant wide.
The scalar sidecut field retains the middle radius 6.9 m for compatibility; the full triple is preserved in sidecutRadii.
Retailer says stance setback 0.75 in and Japanese listing says 19 mm; record 19 mm without presenting it as a brand-primary figure.

The old 160W effectiveEdge 1265 mm, sidecut 8.6 m, setback 40 mm, hybrid profile and listed construction values lacked season-matched support and were replaced by 25/26 retailer evidence. The old 3050 g weight had no reliable source and was removed.
Do not treat the retailer word medium or a reviewer-estimated 6.5/10 on snow as an official numeric RIDE flex scale. Existing site flex 8 remains explicitly unverified pending a normalization policy.
No comparable local CNY price or trustworthy model/size-specific board mass was verified. Existing seed price is not re-sourced by this record.

scoringEvidence.limitations: Reviewer states the demo test was mainly rainy/slushy and less comprehensive than usual. Use only as adjacent-season directional context, not as a 2026 score source.
scoringEvidence.scoreDecision: Keep current six editorial dimensions unchanged and low-confidence; do not map the review's 77.7/100 or subscale observations directly to site scores.
